title: Polytopic Inner Approximation of Admissible Sets for Linear Systems
summary: This paper presents a method for computing inner polytopic approximations of admissible sets for continuous-time linear control systems subject to multiple affine state constraints, with a particular concern on computational tractability for large dimensional problems. In place of globally computing the admissible set and the part of its boundary called the barrier, we compute the so-called individual admissible sets and the corresponding barriers for each single constraint.
